lines.cap: Three clients.
lines.say: Three clients.

lines.cap: One editor.
lines.say: One editor.

lines.cap: Four deadlines.
lines.say: Four deadlines.

lines.cap: So… which job goes first?
lines.say: So... which job goes first?

lines.cap: The easy answer? Work in the order requests arrive.
lines.say: The easy answer? Work in the order requests arrive.

lines.cap: But that queue doesn't know filming isn't done yet. Or that a banner is due at noon.
lines.say: But that queue doesn't know filming isn't done yet. Or that a banner is due at noon!

lines.cap: Guess wrong, and work ships late.
lines.say: Guess wrong, and work ships late.

lines.cap: What if your schedule could think?
lines.say: What if your schedule could think?

lines.cap: Meet CampaignFlow!
lines.say: Meet, CampaignFlow!

lines.cap: Every morning starts with a quick check-in.
lines.say: Every morning starts with a quick check-in.

lines.cap: No forms. No spreadsheets. Just what changed.
lines.say: No forms. No spreadsheets. Just what changed!

lines.cap: Did the client approve? Who's in today?
lines.say: Did the client approve? Who's in today?

lines.cap: Two taps. Done.
lines.say: Two taps. Done!

lines.cap: Then hit Plan!
lines.say: Then hit, Plan!

lines.cap: A min-heap ranks every ready task by urgency and deadline.
lines.say: A min heap ranks every ready task, by urgency, and deadline.

lines.cap: A greedy scheduler fits each one into a teammate's free time, around meetings, around lunch.
lines.say: A greedy scheduler fits each one into a teammate's free time. Around meetings. Around lunch!

lines.cap: Flip to first-come, first-served, and see exactly what the old way would cost you.
lines.say: Flip to first come, first served, and see exactly what the old way would cost you.

lines.cap: Love it? Lock it in!
lines.say: Love it? Lock it in!

lines.cap: Locked work never moves when you replan. Until you say so.
lines.say: Locked work never moves when you re-plan. Until you say so.

lines.cap: New client? New campaign in seconds.
lines.say: New client? New campaign, in seconds.

lines.cap: Templates fill in every step, every link, every estimate.
lines.say: Templates fill in every step. Every link. Every estimate.

lines.cap: And when the client asks for changes, CampaignFlow adds a revision round, without reopening finished work.
lines.say: And when the client asks for changes, CampaignFlow adds a revision round, without reopening finished work.

lines.cap: And it's safe by design.
lines.say: And it's safe, by design.

lines.cap: Create an impossible loop, and depth-first search catches it, and shows you exactly where.
lines.say: Create an impossible loop, and depth first search catches it. And shows you exactly where!

lines.cap: On our demo day: zero late tasks. The old way? One.
lines.say: On our demo day: zero late tasks. The old way? One.

lines.cap: Across twenty synthetic test days: 24% less projected lateness.
lines.say: Across twenty synthetic test days: twenty-four percent less projected lateness.

lines.cap: And it plans 250 tasks in about two milliseconds.
lines.say: And it plans two hundred and fifty tasks, in about two milliseconds.

lines.cap: Stop juggling deadlines.
lines.say: Stop juggling deadlines.

lines.cap: Start shipping.
lines.say: Start shipping!

lines.say: This is, CampaignFlow.
